messages:
Sam_Sales: Hey team — on a POC with Acorn AI. They want to try a new open model 'seabird-20b-v2' and a 4-bit quant variant. Need clarity on catalog availability, kv-cache compatibility for long-context, latency differences Hosted vs Dedicated, rough per-1k-token cost for fp16 vs q4 variants, and whether KMS/keys are supported for a Private deploy. Can we triage?

Tori_Solutions: Noted. Quick summary from presales POV: 1) catalog: we currently have seabird-20b (v1) in the catalog, v2 is not onboarded yet. 2) quant variants: generally supported but need model conversion + quant test. 3) kv-cache: most seq-parallel caches work but depends on tokenization/norm layers. 4) SLA/latency: Dedicated is predictable; Hosted has higher variance.

Ana_ML: I can run a compatibility probe. Questions: what does their prompt distribution look like (avg tokens, typical priming length)? Do they use streaming/function-calls? For q4 we default to q4_k_maybe; we should validate generation fidelity against fp16 before recommending fallback. I can run evals with sample prompts.

Lee_Infra: For ballpark latency: on Dedicated (NVIDIA A10G-like profile) expect p50 ~120-180ms and p99 ~450-600ms for 2048-step requests with batching=8 on seabird-20b FP16. Quant q4 variant can reduce GPU memory and may modestly improve p50 (~20-30%) but depends on kernel support. Hosted: add ~20-40% variance due to multi-tenant routing.

Lee_Infra: Cost sketch (very rough for presales): hosted fp16 ~ $0.035 per 1k tokens, hosted q4 ~ $0.02 per 1k tokens (if available). Dedicated reserved pricing depends on commit tier — I can produce a sample ARR and per-token equivalent once we have expected throughput.

security_bot: KMS notes: Private (VPC/on-prem) supports customer-managed KMS/HSM integration. Dedicated can support BYOK with proper network controls. Hosted: we offer envelope encryption but customers do not control root keys. For the enterprise questionnaire, we need the customer's required key rotation, token retention, and data residency answers.

Tori_Solutions: Action items: - Ana_ML: run compatibility probe + small eval suite on seabird-20b-v2 (if customer supplies v2 binary) or run emulation against v1 + delta test. ETA 48 hours. - Lee_Infra: spin a Dedicated test rig and run perf+cost microbench. ETA 24 hours. - Sam_Sales: collect sample prompt set (10-20 prompts across short/long contexts) and their SLA target (p99 < X ms). I'll draft the customer reply with these knobs.

Sam_Sales: Uploading sample prompts now — pasted below. Also asked customer if fallback to seabird-7b (lower-cost variant) is acceptable in capacity-constrained scenarios. They said yes for degraded mode.

Sam_Sales: ```
Prompt 1: "Summarize meeting notes and extract action items." (avg priming 350 tokens, response target 120 tokens)
Prompt 2: "Answer clinical QA with supporting citations from context." (avg context 1400 tokens)
Prompt 3: "Stream incremental completions for user-facing assistant (function-calls used)."
```

Ana_ML: Good — these cover short, long, and streaming. Plan: 1) run tokenizer parity and KV-cache sanity with v1; 2) run q4 conversion and run 100 sample prompts for perf+quality; 3) run quick rouge/chrF + spot eval. I'll post results and sample diffs. ETA 2 business days.

Lee_Infra: I'll create a dedicated test lane, run steady-state load (rps matching expected POC 50 qps peak) and measure p50/p95/p99 plus GPU utilization and mem footprint. Will attach cost calc for reserved vs burst. Ticketed. ETA 1 business day.

ops_bot: Created infra ticket INF-7891 for test lane + perf runs. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/INF-7891. Pinged infra-oncall.

security_bot: For RFI/RFP: attach SOC2 summary, KMS integration checklist, and network diagram. I'll prepare a redacted compliance packet for customer.

Tori_Solutions: Also confirm fallback orchestration: we can configure routing policy to prefer seabird-20b-v2 on Dedicated, with automatic fallback to seabird-7b hosted/dedicated variant if latency spikes or capacity is constrained. We'll need to validate prompt fidelity on fallback path.

Sam_Sales: Great — looping in legal for contract/commit questions. Please CC me on the final estimate before I send to Acorn AI. :thumbsup:

Ana_ML: Will post probe artifacts (tokenizer diffs, sample outputs) into INF-7891 when done.

Lee_Infra: I'll include a short runbook snippet for the POC: ```
- Spin dedicated lane (docker image: rwd/runtime:canary)
- Load test with bench/runner.py --prompts sample.json --concurrency 50
- Collect kv-cache hit rate, latency histogram, GPU mem logs
```

Sam_Sales: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates in this thread so I can forward a concise summary to the customer.
